title: How to Embed sharethis Share Buttons
text:
## How to Embed sharethis Share Buttons
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000059410
This article covers how to embed third-party ShareThis social media share buttons.

## How to Receive the Code
To embed ShareThis share buttons on web pages, first navigate to https://sharethis.com/ .
Then click on Start with Share Buttons :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104315720/original/YisF5la20KzYXctoUcvIqOGWfK4_zQzHfg.png?1643412211 | alt: ]
Choose from the sharing button options and click on Next :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104315719/original/TSPe1dAvT1ryVFo7HkOdXOUn0Psstn0aGA.png?1643412199 | alt: ]
Important Note: Before clicking Next, customize the share buttons further by clicking "Customize your share buttons":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104315731/original/-5ndkDbvW-cVfhjAPUt-I6z7mkHvqVdubg.png?1643412261 | alt: ]
Drag and order these buttons:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411099/original/8-NDI5f9eAXkLDZoiRpFolzg-7VU8aogKA.gif?1643674407 | alt: ]
Add or remove buttons:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411171/original/K9uCaYH9BG5Kyb4H87zZiAV2IzT04egQeA.gif?1643674558 | alt: ]
It is also possible to further customize the design and settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104413006/original/3khSZ6NHv0S5VKPPJnoL7Lbtvxd5aoerdw.png?1643680073 | alt: ]
After customizing the buttons, click Next . When asked to specify the platform, choose the HTML option and click Next :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104412327/original/avEJHqWI6Ozhvcwl2Sqcz86Gw4pSOGDjFw.png?1643677974 | alt: ]
Log in or sign up to receive the code, then click Get The Code :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104413052/original/ezAuGbg8GXvdERtHM2R97GuLlS90V6v_bw.png?1643680265 | alt: ]
This displays the installation guide for HTML:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104412570/original/fv1X-Kw5bl0nt_vDfp-laRW0T7-yY_DEuQ.png?1643678461 | alt: ]

## How to Embed the Code On Static Pages
To embed the code on static pages, copy the first code:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411958/original/MqdUrRUsvIqoi7PKzy_WOkvmTPqLc5Du6g.png?1643676818 | alt: ]
Paste it into the website's Additional HEAD Code section, under Settings >> Design Settings >> Custom CSS/HEAD :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411930/original/c2FgmeiR0WhrTGd9tPFFxBzxR3g7yJcyTg.png?1643676790 | alt: ]
Then copy the second code:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411924/original/m7cpKCXi4I5a37DYmR7wajqeS15cOu3Ddw.png?1643676769 | alt: ]
Navigate to Toolbox >> Widget Manager and click New Widget :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411283/original/EehGSibgb4KKLgPZJO--FLMyKWALVoYhxg.png?1643675132 | alt: ]
Create the new widget with the second code:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411289/original/dd-fgOSLsNsbUUuDnOdzdkzydH7EdH0UOg.png?1643675144 | alt: ]
Copy the new widget's Shortcode :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411303/original/xMHGaTLkn26qtfkxmugDAN7oyzRd4lFJFg.png?1643675192 | alt: ]
With the widget's shortcode, call these buttons on any page. Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder then click Edit on an existing page or click New Web Page to create a new one:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411595/original/ix50AcZ-ujwDPVj7vD9fOUZpy5dnPt901Q.png?1643676052 | alt: ]
And simply paste the code in the text editor section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104411677/original/zw_FDVnX9h_qtsb-re-KU36ybatKxORwTQ.png?1643676239 | alt: ]
The buttons will appear on the front-end page immediately:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079372572/original/OHZ5Wzvrma6lLvqLvTdatouMF3EYz4zRQw.png?1593528290 | alt: ]
